name: Build
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
jobs:
  todos_linux:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - name: Install cargo-deb
      run: cargo install cargo-deb
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu
        path: target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb

  todos_windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Enable static CRT linkage
      run: |
        echo '[target.x86_64-pc-windows-msvc]' >> .cargo/config
        echo 'rustflags = ["-Ctarget-feature=+crt-static"]' >> .cargo/config
    - name: Run the application without starting the shell
      run: |
        sed -i '1 i\#![windows_subsystem = \"windows\"]' examples/todos/src/main.rs
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
        path: target/release-opt/todos.exe

  todos_macos:
    runs-on: macOS-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Build todos binary
      env:
        MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: 10.14
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Open binary via double-click
      run: chmod +x target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-apple-darwin
        path: target/release-opt/todos

  todos_raspberry:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install cross
      run: cargo install cross
    - name: Build todos binary for Raspberry Pi 3/4 (64 bits)
      run: cross build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/release-opt/todos
    - name: Build todos binary for Raspberry Pi 2/3/4 (32 bits)
      run: cross build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos --target armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
        path: target/armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf/release-opt/todos

name: Test
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  all:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    env:
      RUSTFLAGS: --deny warnings
      ICED_TEST_BACKEND: tiny-skia
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macOS-latest]
        rust: [stable, beta, "1.85"]
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
      with:
        rust-version: ${{ matrix.rust }}
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      if: matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest'
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev libgtk-3-dev
    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        cargo test --verbose --workspace -- --ignored
        cargo test --verbose --workspace --all-features -- --ignored

name: Build
on:

jobs:
  todos_linux:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - name: Install cargo-deb
      run: cargo install cargo-deb
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu
        path: target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb

  todos_windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest

    - name: Enable static CRT linkage

    - name: Run the application without starting the shell

    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:

jobs:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - name: Install cargo-deb
      run: cargo install cargo-deb
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu
        path: target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb

  todos_windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Enable static CRT linkage
      run: |

    - name: Run the application without starting the shell

    - name: Build todos binary

    - name: Archive todos binary

      with:

name: Build
on:

jobs:
  todos_linux:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - name: Install cargo-deb
      run: cargo install cargo-deb
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu
        path: target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb

  todos_windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Enable static CRT linkage
      run: |
        echo '[target.x86_64-pc-windows-msvc]' >> .cargo/config
        echo 'rustflags = ["-Ctarget-feature=+crt-static"]' >> .cargo/config
    - name: Run the application without starting the shell
      run: |
        sed -i '1 i\#![windows_subsystem = \"windows\"]' examples/todos/src/main.rs
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc

  todos_macos:

    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master

    - name: Archive todos binary

name: Build
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
jobs:
  todos_linux:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - name: Install cargo-deb
      run: cargo install cargo-deb
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu
        path: target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb

  todos_windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Enable static CRT linkage
      run: |
        echo '[target.x86_64-pc-windows-msvc]' >> .cargo/config
        echo 'rustflags = ["-Ctarget-feature=+crt-static"]' >> .cargo/config
    - name: Run the application without starting the shell
      run: |
        sed -i '1 i\#![windows_subsystem = \"windows\"]' examples/todos/src/main.rs
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
        path: target/release-opt/todos.exe

  todos_macos:
    runs-on: macOS-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Build todos binary
      env:
        MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: 10.14

    - name: Open binary via double-click

    - name: Archive todos binary

      with:

        path: target/release-opt/todos

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:

      run: cargo install cargo-deb
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update

      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:

        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4

    - name: Run the application without starting the shell

    - name: Build todos binary

jobs:
  todos_linux:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - name: Install cargo-deb
      run: cargo install cargo-deb
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu
        path: target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb

  todos_windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Enable static CRT linkage
      run: |
        echo '[target.x86_64-pc-windows-msvc]' >> .cargo/config
        echo 'rustflags = ["-Ctarget-feature=+crt-static"]' >> .cargo/config
    - name: Run the application without starting the shell
      run: |
        sed -i '1 i\#![windows_subsystem = \"windows\"]' examples/todos/src/main.rs
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
        path: target/release-opt/todos.exe

  todos_macos:
    runs-on: macOS-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Build todos binary
      env:
        MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: 10.14
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Open binary via double-click
      run: chmod +x target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-apple-darwin
        path: target/release-opt/todos

    - uses: actions/checkout@master

        name: todos-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/release-opt/todos
    - name: Build todos binary for Raspberry Pi 2/3/4 (32 bits)

      with:
        name: todos-armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
        path: target/armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf/release-opt/todos

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - name: Install cargo-deb
      run: cargo install cargo-deb
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu
        path: target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb

  todos_windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Enable static CRT linkage
      run: |
        echo '[target.x86_64-pc-windows-msvc]' >> .cargo/config
        echo 'rustflags = ["-Ctarget-feature=+crt-static"]' >> .cargo/config
    - name: Run the application without starting the shell
      run: |
        sed -i '1 i\#![windows_subsystem = \"windows\"]' examples/todos/src/main.rs
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
        path: target/release-opt/todos.exe

  todos_macos:

    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Build todos binary
      env:
        MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: 10.14
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Open binary via double-click

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - name: Install cargo-deb
      run: cargo install cargo-deb
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu

name: Build
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
jobs:
  todos_linux:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - name: Install cargo-deb
      run: cargo install cargo-deb
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu
        path: target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb

  todos_windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Enable static CRT linkage
      run: |
        echo '[target.x86_64-pc-windows-msvc]' >> .cargo/config
        echo 'rustflags = ["-Ctarget-feature=+crt-static"]' >> .cargo/config
    - name: Run the application without starting the shell
      run: |
        sed -i '1 i\#![windows_subsystem = \"windows\"]' examples/todos/src/main.rs
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
        path: target/release-opt/todos.exe

  todos_macos:
    runs-on: macOS-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Build todos binary
      env:
        MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: 10.14
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Open binary via double-click
      run: chmod +x target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-apple-darwin
        path: target/release-opt/todos

  todos_raspberry:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install cross
      run: cargo install cross
    - name: Build todos binary for Raspberry Pi 3/4 (64 bits)
      run: cross build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/release-opt/todos
    - name: Build todos binary for Raspberry Pi 2/3/4 (32 bits)
      run: cross build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos --target armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
        path: target/armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf/release-opt/todos

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu
        path: target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb

name: Build
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
jobs:
  todos_linux:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - name: Install cargo-deb
      run: cargo install cargo-deb
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu
        path: target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb

  todos_windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Enable static CRT linkage
      run: |
        echo '[target.x86_64-pc-windows-msvc]' >> .cargo/config
        echo 'rustflags = ["-Ctarget-feature=+crt-static"]' >> .cargo/config
    - name: Run the application without starting the shell
      run: |
        sed -i '1 i\#![windows_subsystem = \"windows\"]' examples/todos/src/main.rs
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
        path: target/release-opt/todos.exe

  todos_macos:
    runs-on: macOS-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Build todos binary
      env:
        MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: 10.14
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Open binary via double-click
      run: chmod +x target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-apple-darwin
        path: target/release-opt/todos

  todos_raspberry:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install cross
      run: cargo install cross
    - name: Build todos binary for Raspberry Pi 3/4 (64 bits)
      run: cross build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/release-opt/todos
    - name: Build todos binary for Raspberry Pi 2/3/4 (32 bits)
      run: cross build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos --target armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
        path: target/armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf/release-opt/todos

name: Build
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
jobs:
  todos_linux:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - name: Install cargo-deb
      run: cargo install cargo-deb
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu
        path: target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb

  todos_windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Enable static CRT linkage
      run: |
        echo '[target.x86_64-pc-windows-msvc]' >> .cargo/config
        echo 'rustflags = ["-Ctarget-feature=+crt-static"]' >> .cargo/config
    - name: Run the application without starting the shell
      run: |
        sed -i '1 i\#![windows_subsystem = \"windows\"]' examples/todos/src/main.rs
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
        path: target/release-opt/todos.exe

  todos_macos:
    runs-on: macOS-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Build todos binary
      env:
        MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: 10.14
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Open binary via double-click
      run: chmod +x target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-apple-darwin
        path: target/release-opt/todos

  todos_raspberry:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install cross
      run: cargo install cross
    - name: Build todos binary for Raspberry Pi 3/4 (64 bits)
      run: cross build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/release-opt/todos
    - name: Build todos binary for Raspberry Pi 2/3/4 (32 bits)
      run: cross build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos --target armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
        path: target/armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf/release-opt/todos

name: Test
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  all:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    env:
      RUSTFLAGS: --deny warnings
      ICED_TEST_BACKEND: tiny-skia
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macOS-latest]
        rust: [stable, beta, "1.85"]
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
      with:
        rust-version: ${{ matrix.rust }}
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      if: matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest'
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev libgtk-3-dev
    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        cargo test --verbose --workspace -- --ignored
        cargo test --verbose --workspace --all-features -- --ignored

    steps:

    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu
        path: target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb

  todos_windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Enable static CRT linkage
      run: |
        echo '[target.x86_64-pc-windows-msvc]' >> .cargo/config
        echo 'rustflags = ["-Ctarget-feature=+crt-static"]' >> .cargo/config
    - name: Run the application without starting the shell

        sed -i '1 i\#![windows_subsystem = \"windows\"]' examples/todos/src/main.rs
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
        path: target/release-opt/todos.exe

    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Build todos binary
      env:

      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Open binary via double-click

    - name: Archive todos binary

name: Build
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
jobs:
  todos_linux:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - name: Install cargo-deb
      run: cargo install cargo-deb
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu
        path: target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb

  todos_windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Enable static CRT linkage
      run: |
        echo '[target.x86_64-pc-windows-msvc]' >> .cargo/config
        echo 'rustflags = ["-Ctarget-feature=+crt-static"]' >> .cargo/config
    - name: Run the application without starting the shell
      run: |
        sed -i '1 i\#![windows_subsystem = \"windows\"]' examples/todos/src/main.rs
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
        path: target/release-opt/todos.exe

  todos_macos:
    runs-on: macOS-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Build todos binary
      env:
        MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: 10.14
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Open binary via double-click
      run: chmod +x target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-apple-darwin
        path: target/release-opt/todos

  todos_raspberry:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install cross
      run: cargo install cross
    - name: Build todos binary for Raspberry Pi 3/4 (64 bits)
      run: cross build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/release-opt/todos
    - name: Build todos binary for Raspberry Pi 2/3/4 (32 bits)
      run: cross build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos --target armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
        path: target/armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf/release-opt/todos

jobs:
  all:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    env:
      RUSTFLAGS: --deny warnings
      ICED_TEST_BACKEND: tiny-skia

      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macOS-latest]
        rust: [stable, beta, "1.85"]
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
      with:
        rust-version: ${{ matrix.rust }}
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      if: matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest'
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev libgtk-3-dev
    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        cargo test --verbose --workspace -- --ignored
        cargo test --verbose --workspace --all-features -- --ignored

name: Build
on:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - name: Install cargo-deb
      run: cargo install cargo-deb
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu
        path: target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb

  todos_windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Enable static CRT linkage

      with:

      run: |

        sudo apt-get -qq update

    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu

name: Build
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
jobs:
  todos_linux:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - name: Install cargo-deb
      run: cargo install cargo-deb
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu
        path: target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb

  todos_windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Enable static CRT linkage
      run: |
        echo '[target.x86_64-pc-windows-msvc]' >> .cargo/config
        echo 'rustflags = ["-Ctarget-feature=+crt-static"]' >> .cargo/config
    - name: Run the application without starting the shell
      run: |
        sed -i '1 i\#![windows_subsystem = \"windows\"]' examples/todos/src/main.rs
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
        path: target/release-opt/todos.exe

  todos_macos:
    runs-on: macOS-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Build todos binary
      env:
        MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: 10.14
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Open binary via double-click
      run: chmod +x target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-apple-darwin
        path: target/release-opt/todos

  todos_raspberry:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install cross
      run: cargo install cross
    - name: Build todos binary for Raspberry Pi 3/4 (64 bits)
      run: cross build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/release-opt/todos
    - name: Build todos binary for Raspberry Pi 2/3/4 (32 bits)
      run: cross build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos --target armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
        path: target/armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf/release-opt/todos

name: Build
on:
  push:

      - master
jobs:
  todos_linux:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - name: Install cargo-deb
      run: cargo install cargo-deb
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu
        path: target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb

  todos_windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Enable static CRT linkage
      run: |
        echo '[target.x86_64-pc-windows-msvc]' >> .cargo/config
        echo 'rustflags = ["-Ctarget-feature=+crt-static"]' >> .cargo/config
    - name: Run the application without starting the shell
      run: |
        sed -i '1 i\#![windows_subsystem = \"windows\"]' examples/todos/src/main.rs
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
        path: target/release-opt/todos.exe

  todos_macos:
    runs-on: macOS-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Build todos binary
      env:
        MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: 10.14
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Open binary via double-click
      run: chmod +x target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-apple-darwin
        path: target/release-opt/todos

  todos_raspberry:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install cross
      run: cargo install cross
    - name: Build todos binary for Raspberry Pi 3/4 (64 bits)
      run: cross build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/release-opt/todos
    - name: Build todos binary for Raspberry Pi 2/3/4 (32 bits)
      run: cross build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos --target armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
        path: target/armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf/release-opt/todos

name: Build
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
jobs:
  todos_linux:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - name: Install cargo-deb
      run: cargo install cargo-deb
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu
        path: target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb

  todos_windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Enable static CRT linkage
      run: |
        echo '[target.x86_64-pc-windows-msvc]' >> .cargo/config
        echo 'rustflags = ["-Ctarget-feature=+crt-static"]' >> .cargo/config
    - name: Run the application without starting the shell
      run: |
        sed -i '1 i\#![windows_subsystem = \"windows\"]' examples/todos/src/main.rs
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
        path: target/release-opt/todos.exe

  todos_macos:
    runs-on: macOS-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Build todos binary
      env:
        MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: 10.14
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Open binary via double-click
      run: chmod +x target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-apple-darwin
        path: target/release-opt/todos

  todos_raspberry:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install cross
      run: cargo install cross
    - name: Build todos binary for Raspberry Pi 3/4 (64 bits)
      run: cross build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/release-opt/todos
    - name: Build todos binary for Raspberry Pi 2/3/4 (32 bits)
      run: cross build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos --target armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
        path: target/armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf/release-opt/todos

name: Build
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
jobs:
  todos_linux:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - name: Install cargo-deb
      run: cargo install cargo-deb
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu
        path: target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb

  todos_windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Enable static CRT linkage
      run: |
        echo '[target.x86_64-pc-windows-msvc]' >> .cargo/config
        echo 'rustflags = ["-Ctarget-feature=+crt-static"]' >> .cargo/config
    - name: Run the application without starting the shell
      run: |
        sed -i '1 i\#![windows_subsystem = \"windows\"]' examples/todos/src/main.rs
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
        path: target/release-opt/todos.exe

  todos_macos:
    runs-on: macOS-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Build todos binary
      env:
        MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: 10.14
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Open binary via double-click
      run: chmod +x target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-apple-darwin
        path: target/release-opt/todos

  todos_raspberry:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install cross
      run: cargo install cross
    - name: Build todos binary for Raspberry Pi 3/4 (64 bits)
      run: cross build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/release-opt/todos
    - name: Build todos binary for Raspberry Pi 2/3/4 (32 bits)
      run: cross build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos --target armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
        path: target/armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf/release-opt/todos

name: Build
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
jobs:
  todos_linux:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - name: Install cargo-deb
      run: cargo install cargo-deb
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu
        path: target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb

  todos_windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Enable static CRT linkage
      run: |
        echo '[target.x86_64-pc-windows-msvc]' >> .cargo/config
        echo 'rustflags = ["-Ctarget-feature=+crt-static"]' >> .cargo/config
    - name: Run the application without starting the shell
      run: |
        sed -i '1 i\#![windows_subsystem = \"windows\"]' examples/todos/src/main.rs
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
        path: target/release-opt/todos.exe

  todos_macos:
    runs-on: macOS-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Build todos binary
      env:
        MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: 10.14
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Open binary via double-click
      run: chmod +x target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-apple-darwin
        path: target/release-opt/todos

  todos_raspberry:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install cross
      run: cargo install cross
    - name: Build todos binary for Raspberry Pi 3/4 (64 bits)
      run: cross build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/release-opt/todos
    - name: Build todos binary for Raspberry Pi 2/3/4 (32 bits)
      run: cross build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos --target armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
        path: target/armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf/release-opt/todos

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:

      run: cargo install cargo-deb
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu
        path: target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb

  todos_windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Enable static CRT linkage
      run: |
        echo '[target.x86_64-pc-windows-msvc]' >> .cargo/config
        echo 'rustflags = ["-Ctarget-feature=+crt-static"]' >> .cargo/config
    - name: Run the application without starting the shell
      run: |
        sed -i '1 i\#![windows_subsystem = \"windows\"]' examples/todos/src/main.rs
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
        path: target/release-opt/todos.exe

    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Build todos binary
      env:

      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Open binary via double-click

name: Build
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
jobs:
  todos_linux:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - name: Install cargo-deb
      run: cargo install cargo-deb
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu
        path: target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb

  todos_windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Enable static CRT linkage
      run: |
        echo '[target.x86_64-pc-windows-msvc]' >> .cargo/config
        echo 'rustflags = ["-Ctarget-feature=+crt-static"]' >> .cargo/config
    - name: Run the application without starting the shell
      run: |
        sed -i '1 i\#![windows_subsystem = \"windows\"]' examples/todos/src/main.rs
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
        path: target/release-opt/todos.exe

  todos_macos:
    runs-on: macOS-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Build todos binary
      env:
        MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: 10.14
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Open binary via double-click
      run: chmod +x target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-apple-darwin
        path: target/release-opt/todos

  todos_raspberry:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install cross
      run: cargo install cross
    - name: Build todos binary for Raspberry Pi 3/4 (64 bits)

      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:

        path: target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/release-opt/todos
    - name: Build todos binary for Raspberry Pi 2/3/4 (32 bits)

    - name: Archive todos binary

      with:
        name: todos-armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
        path: target/armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf/release-opt/todos

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2

      run: cargo install cargo-deb
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu
        path: target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb

name: Build
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master

  todos_linux:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - name: Install cargo-deb
      run: cargo install cargo-deb
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |

        sudo apt-get -qq update

    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu

    - name: Pack todos .deb package

    - name: Rename todos .deb package

    - name: Archive todos .deb package

    - name: Enable static CRT linkage
      run: |
        echo '[target.x86_64-pc-windows-msvc]' >> .cargo/config
        echo 'rustflags = ["-Ctarget-feature=+crt-static"]' >> .cargo/config
    - name: Run the application without starting the shell
      run: |
        sed -i '1 i\#![windows_subsystem = \"windows\"]' examples/todos/src/main.rs
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
        path: target/release-opt/todos.exe

    runs-on: macOS-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Build todos binary
      env:
        MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: 10.14
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Open binary via double-click
      run: chmod +x target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-apple-darwin
        path: target/release-opt/todos

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    - name: Archive todos binary

on:

jobs:
  todos_linux:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - name: Install cargo-deb
      run: cargo install cargo-deb
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu
        path: target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb

  todos_windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Enable static CRT linkage
      run: |
        echo '[target.x86_64-pc-windows-msvc]' >> .cargo/config
        echo 'rustflags = ["-Ctarget-feature=+crt-static"]' >> .cargo/config
    - name: Run the application without starting the shell
      run: |
        sed -i '1 i\#![windows_subsystem = \"windows\"]' examples/todos/src/main.rs
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
        path: target/release-opt/todos.exe

  todos_macos:
    runs-on: macOS-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Build todos binary
      env:
        MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: 10.14
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Open binary via double-click
      run: chmod +x target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-apple-darwin
        path: target/release-opt/todos

  todos_raspberry:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install cross
      run: cargo install cross

      with:
        name: todos-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/release-opt/todos
    - name: Build todos binary for Raspberry Pi 2/3/4 (32 bits)

      with:
        name: todos-armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
        path: target/armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf/release-opt/todos

name: Build
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
jobs:
  todos_linux:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - name: Install cargo-deb
      run: cargo install cargo-deb
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu
        path: target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb

  todos_windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Enable static CRT linkage
      run: |
        echo '[target.x86_64-pc-windows-msvc]' >> .cargo/config
        echo 'rustflags = ["-Ctarget-feature=+crt-static"]' >> .cargo/config
    - name: Run the application without starting the shell
      run: |
        sed -i '1 i\#![windows_subsystem = \"windows\"]' examples/todos/src/main.rs
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
        path: target/release-opt/todos.exe

  todos_macos:
    runs-on: macOS-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Build todos binary
      env:
        MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: 10.14
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Open binary via double-click
      run: chmod +x target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-apple-darwin
        path: target/release-opt/todos

  todos_raspberry:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install cross
      run: cargo install cross
    - name: Build todos binary for Raspberry Pi 3/4 (64 bits)
      run: cross build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/release-opt/todos
    - name: Build todos binary for Raspberry Pi 2/3/4 (32 bits)
      run: cross build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos --target armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
        path: target/armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf/release-opt/todos

name: Build
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
jobs:
  todos_linux:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - name: Install cargo-deb
      run: cargo install cargo-deb
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu
        path: target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb

  todos_windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Enable static CRT linkage
      run: |
        echo '[target.x86_64-pc-windows-msvc]' >> .cargo/config
        echo 'rustflags = ["-Ctarget-feature=+crt-static"]' >> .cargo/config
    - name: Run the application without starting the shell
      run: |
        sed -i '1 i\#![windows_subsystem = \"windows\"]' examples/todos/src/main.rs
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
        path: target/release-opt/todos.exe

  todos_macos:
    runs-on: macOS-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Build todos binary
      env:
        MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: 10.14
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Open binary via double-click
      run: chmod +x target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-apple-darwin
        path: target/release-opt/todos

  todos_raspberry:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master

        path: target/armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf/release-opt/todos

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    env:
      RUSTFLAGS: --deny warnings
      ICED_TEST_BACKEND: tiny-skia
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macOS-latest]
        rust: [stable, beta, "1.85"]
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
      with:
        rust-version: ${{ matrix.rust }}
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      if: matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest'
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev libgtk-3-dev
    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        cargo test --verbose --workspace -- --ignored
        cargo test --verbose --workspace --all-features -- --ignored

   Here’s an example template for your Dockerfile:
   ```
   FROM rust:latest  # Adjust the base image based on the project's language and dependencies

name: Build
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
jobs:
  todos_linux:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - name: Install cargo-deb
      run: cargo install cargo-deb
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu
        path: target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb

  todos_windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Enable static CRT linkage
      run: |
        echo '[target.x86_64-pc-windows-msvc]' >> .cargo/config
        echo 'rustflags = ["-Ctarget-feature=+crt-static"]' >> .cargo/config
    - name: Run the application without starting the shell
      run: |
        sed -i '1 i\#![windows_subsystem = \"windows\"]' examples/todos/src/main.rs
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
        path: target/release-opt/todos.exe

  todos_macos:
    runs-on: macOS-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Build todos binary
      env:
        MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: 10.14
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Open binary via double-click
      run: chmod +x target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-apple-darwin
        path: target/release-opt/todos

  todos_raspberry:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install cross
      run: cargo install cross
    - name: Build todos binary for Raspberry Pi 3/4 (64 bits)
      run: cross build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/release-opt/todos
    - name: Build todos binary for Raspberry Pi 2/3/4 (32 bits)
      run: cross build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos --target armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
        path: target/armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf/release-opt/todos

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2

      run: cargo install cargo-deb
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu

on:

jobs:
  todos_linux:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - name: Install cargo-deb
      run: cargo install cargo-deb
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        export DEBIAN_FRONTED=noninteractive
        sudo apt-get -qq update
        sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu
        path: target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb

  todos_windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Enable static CRT linkage
      run: |
        echo '[target.x86_64-pc-windows-msvc]' >> .cargo/config
        echo 'rustflags = ["-Ctarget-feature=+crt-static"]' >> .cargo/config
    - name: Run the application without starting the shell
      run: |
        sed -i '1 i\#![windows_subsystem = \"windows\"]' examples/todos/src/main.rs
    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
        path: target/release-opt/todos.exe

  todos_macos:
    runs-on: macOS-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Build todos binary
      env:
        MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: 10.14
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Open binary via double-click
      run: chmod +x target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-apple-darwin
        path: target/release-opt/todos

  todos_raspberry:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: hecrj/setup-rust-action@v2
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Install cross
      run: cargo install cross

      with:
        name: todos-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/release-opt/todos
    - name: Build todos binary for Raspberry Pi 2/3/4 (32 bits)

        name: todos-armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
        path: target/armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf/release-opt/todos

    steps:

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |

        sudo apt-get -qq update

    - name: Build todos binary
      run: cargo build --verbose --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Archive todos binary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: todos-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        path: target/release-opt/todos
    - name: Pack todos .deb package
      run: cargo deb --no-build --profile release-opt --package todos
    - name: Rename todos .deb package
      run: mv target/debian/*.deb target/debian/iced_todos-x86_64-debian-linux-gnu.deb
    - name: Archive todos .deb package
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
